{{Wireless adapter |brand=Lucent |model=ORiNOCO Classic |revision=(USB) |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date=2001 |fcc_date=07/20/1999 |manuf_country=Taiwan |is_manuf=No |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=1.1 |if_connector_type=Female B |form_factor=corded (modular) adapter |vendor_id=047e |device_id=0300 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=IMRWLPCE24H |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Lucent |chip1_model=HERMES I |chip2_brand=Lucent |chip2_model=THESEUS HS |chip3_brand=Philips |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips=EZ-USB FX MCU;Cypress Semiconductor;CY7C64613;CYPRESS, CY7C64613-128NC, 0122, CNZ4138 KOREA;1; ,,, SRAM (32KB, 32K x 8, 3.3V);Cypress Semiconductor;CY7C1399L-15VC;;1; |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=MC |802dot11_protocols=b |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:02:2D |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device is an [[ORiNOCO PC Card]] in an adapter which allows it to be used over a USB bus. The adapter uses a Cypress EZ-USB chip.
This device is not to be confused with the [[ORiNOCO LC USB Client]], which has essentially the same appearance.. but instead of an [[ORiNOCO PC Card]], the device integrates all components onto a single board (and also uses a newer '''Ruby''' radio, which requires newer firmware).
This device was also sold as the '''Zoom''' 4115. The HP P1980A is a Silver USB Client (with the same USB ID as the standard ORiNOCO client - 047e:0300).
